title: Public Sector Casework, Grants & Higher-Ed Ops Configuration

org_configured.description: True once Public Sector Casework, Grants & Higher-Ed Ops organization thresholds and connectors are configured.

organization_name.description: Tenant legal entity or department name.

sheet_map.description: Optional mapping from canonical table key (e.g. invoices) to customer worksheet tab name.

column_map.description: Optional mapping from customer column header or connector JSON field name to canonical engine field name.

base_fpl_single_usd.description: 100% Federal Poverty Level annual income baseline for single household.

eligibility_fpl_multiplier.description: FPL income threshold multiplier for statutory program qualification.

statutory_cure_window_days.description: Statutory notice window in days to cure missing application documents.

max_indirect_fa_rate_pct.description: University/agency negotiated F&A indirect cost ceiling % on MTDC base.

max_evidence_age_days.description: Maximum allowed age in days for accreditation evidence artifacts.
